chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Ayoub al-Khazzaz, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about Tayammum, so he said: 'Ammar ibn Yasir was afflicted with Janabah (major ritual impurity), so he rolled upon the ground as an animal rolls. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: 'O Ammar, you rolled as the animal rolls.' So I said to him, 'How is the Tayammum?' So he placed his hand upon the rough cloth (Misah), then raised it, so he wiped his face, then wiped above the wrist a little.' And it is reported from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub.
ai.seo_question: What is the correct method for performing Tayammum according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of Yunus ibn Abi al-Abbas, establishes the Sunnah of Tayammum by recounting the Prophet’s (saww) correction of Ammar ibn Yasir, who had excessively rolled in the dust due to forgetfulness. It clarifies the specific physical action of wiping the face and the back of the hands, a detail highly valued in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing the proper method from mere contact with the earth. The narration underscores the principle that excessive movement does not invalidate the ritual if the essential act of wiping is performed correctly.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Tayammum, so heasws said: ‘Ammar Bin Yasser was hit by the sexual impurity, so he rolled upon the ground like the rolling of the animal. So Rasool-Allahsaww said to him: ‘O Ammar! You are rolling just as the animal does’. So I said to himasws, ‘How is the Tayammum?’ So heasws placed hisasws hand upon the rough cloth, then raised it, so heasws wiped hisasws face, then wiped above the wrist, a little’.
And it is reported from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from ibn abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about Tayammum.

He (the Imam) said, “Ammar ibn Yasir once had experienced sexual relation and he rolled himself on the ground as certain animals do. The Messenger of Allah said, ‘O ‘Ammar, you rolled yourself on the ground as certain animals do.’ I (the narrator) then asked him (the Imam), ‘How is Tayammum done?’ He (the Imam) placed his hand on the sackcloth, then raised it and wiped his face, then the backs of his hands slightly.” He (the narrator) has narrated it (the previous Hadith) from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Ayyub also.
